artifacts.bundle_name: Charlie Kirk JFK Assassination Discussion Clip (May 2025)

sub_items.description: Video clip of Charlie Kirk speaking at a Turning Point event in May 2025, asked about the JFK assassination

artifacts.bundle_name: Kash Patel / Megyn Kelly Interview Bundle

sub_items.description: On-camera exchange in which Megyn Kelly asks FBI Director Kash Patel whether France was involved in Charlie Kirk's assassination and whether Candace Owens received a credible French death threat
Read-aloud excerpts from a website identified as "Corruption Tracker" describing Pierre Falcone's criminal case, conviction, appeal outcome, and reduced sentence
Read-aloud quote from a website identified as "CorpWatch" describing the Angolagate scandal, citing a March 25 Global Witness report ("All the President's Men")

artifacts.bundle_name: One Shot TV .30-06 Ballistic Test Video Bundle

sub_items.description: YouTube video by Jesse Kege (channel: One Shot TV) testing .30-06 180gr FMJ and 150gr Hornady ballistic tip rounds against a ballistic dummy with three 5-gallon water jugs behind it, shot from a downward angle mimicking the alleged scene geometry

Tweet from the Hodge Twins asserting that Republicans will lose midterms because deep state criminals have not been held accountable, money is sent to corrupt foreign countries, and establishment figures are promoted
Viewer comment from "Jo Ann": "we hoped it would go away" – referenced as first truthful statement made by TPUSA
Viewer comment from "Assad O Bros": testimony that watching the "Brigitte series" led to purchasing a first Bible
Viewer comment from "Diana Sheen": question whether TPUSA employees must stay silent if crime is involved
Viewer comment from "AZ Master Baker": dates given for Erika with Bari Weiss (13th), TPUSA podcast (15th), TPUSA AmFest (18th)
Viewer comment from "CCXX": references life insurance taken out on Charlie Kirk and $1.5 million routing; mentions Daily Mail story on life insurance
Viewer comment from "Laughing Cats Music World" – referenced but contents not read in full (request for post to TPUSA asking specific questions)
Host verbal reference to a tip received from overseas that TPUSA-linked people took a meeting with Pierre Falcone (not shown)

artifacts.bundle_name: Decentralized Intelligence Agency Tip Line Bundle

sub_items.description: Host verbal call for more tips at candaceowens.com

artifacts.bundle_name: Tim Pool Show Milo Yiannopoulos Segment Bundle

sub_items.description: Clip played of Milo Yiannopoulos, George Santos and Tim Pool discussing Epstein files, Trumpism and the Turning Point account
Host verbal description of what Tim Pool said on the same show about her viewers and his lost subscribers (not shown)
Host verbal reference to a tip from someone within TPUSA about Charlie's messages the night before the assassination (not shown)
Host verbal reference to a Qatari interview about its relationship with Hamas (not shown)

claims.label: Charlie Kirk asserted that more than one person was involved in the JFK assassination
claims.claim: In a May 2025 recorded clip, Charlie Kirk stated that more than one person was involved in the JFK assassination and that the lone-Oswald reading was insufficient.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited clip and confirm Kirk's exact wording, including the listed anomalies (route change, open-air convertible, LBJ not riding, slowdown at the Depository).

claims.label: Charlie Kirk asserted that parts of the US government, Lyndon Baines Johnson, and Cubans wanted JFK dead
claims.claim: In the same May 2025 clip, Charlie Kirk named Lyndon Baines Johnson, parts of the US government, and Cubans as actors who wanted JFK dead.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full source clip to verify Kirk's exact phrasing and identify the venue and interviewer.

claims.label: Kash Patel did not deny French involvement in Charlie Kirk's assassination when directly asked by Megyn Kelly
claims.claim: When Megyn Kelly directly asked FBI Director Kash Patel whether the French were involved in Charlie Kirk's assassination, Patel did not address the allegation and instead spoke in general terms about investigating threats to any American.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited Megyn Kelly / Kash Patel interview segment to verify exact wording and identify any non-verbal cues or follow-up questions.

claims.label: Pierre Falcone was convicted in France of arms trafficking, breach of trust, misuse of corporate assets, and bribery
claims.claim: According to source material read aloud by the host and attributed to "Corruption Tracker," Pierre Falcone was convicted of arms trafficking, breach of trust, misuse of corporate assets, and bribery.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain primary French court records or a contemporaneous news report of the conviction to confirm charges and dates.

claims.label: Pierre Falcone's conviction was overturned on appeal and replaced with a reduced 2.5-year sentence
claims.claim: According to source material read aloud, Pierre Falcone's original six-year sentence was overturned on appeal and replaced with a 2.5-year sentence.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the appellate decision and confirm the precise revised sentence and the date it was imposed.

claims.label: Pierre Falcone is described as currently residing in Scottsdale, Arizona
claims.claim: The host states that Pierre Falcone reappeared in Scottsdale, Arizona, the same location as Turning Point USA.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Pierre Falcone's current residence via property records, business filings, or U.S. immigration records.

claims.label: Arcadi Gaydamak was convicted in absentia in France of arms trafficking, tax fraud, bribery, and money laundering
claims.claim: According to source material read aloud, Arcadi Gaydamak was convicted (without appearing in France) of arms trafficking, tax fraud, bribery, and money laundering.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the French court judgment against Gaydamak and confirm the conviction and date.

claims.label: The Angolagate scandal involved France, Israel, Angola, Russia, Slovakia, and the United States
claims.claim: According to a CorpWatch source read aloud by the host, the Angolagate scandal involved France, Israel, Angola, Russia, Slovakia, and the United States.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the March 25 Global Witness report "All the President's Men" with CorpWatch and the original French judicial findings.

claims.label: Approximately $463 million in arms were transferred to Angola via Brenco International and the Mitterrand access channel
claims.claim: According to a CorpWatch article citing a March 25 Global Witness report, Brenco International and the Mitterrand access channel transferred approximately $463 million in arms to Angola.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original Global Witness report figures and the French prosecutor's findings on arms volumes.

claims.label: Jean-Christophe Mitterrand, son of former French president François Mitterrand, was implicated in Angolagate
claims.claim: According to a CorpWatch source, Jean-Christophe Mitterrand (son of former French president François Mitterrand) was implicated in Angolagate as having provided access to the Angolan government.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Jean-Christophe Mitterrand's role via French court records.

claims.label: Clip the Host Plays Shows Jesse Kege / One Shot TV 180gr FMJ .30-06 Round Fully Penetrating Ballistic Dummy and Three 5-Gallon Water Jugs
claims.claim: In a video the host plays, YouTuber Jesse Kege of One Shot TV demonstrates a 180gr FMJ .30-06 round penetrating a ballistic dummy, separating its head, and continuing through three 5-gallon water jugs placed behind; the host cites this as showing what the round would have done to Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full One Shot TV video, including any second-round test (150gr Hornady ballistic tip), and verify the exact penetration result shown.

claims.label: The One Shot TV .30-06 demonstration is presented as evidence challenging the official ballistics narrative
claims.claim: The host characterizes the One Shot TV result – that the dummy's head was severed and the round continued through water jugs – as evidence that the official story's depiction of a .30-06 ricochet is implausible.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference the One Shot TV demonstration with official forensic findings released by authorities.

claims.label: The Hodge Twins publicly stated that Republicans will lose midterms because no deep state criminals have been held accountable
claims.claim: According to a tweet from the Hodge Twins read aloud by the host, Republicans will lose midterms because no deep state criminals have been held accountable, money is sent to corrupt foreign countries, and establishment figures are being promoted.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original tweet and confirm the exact text.

claims.label: A viewer comment asserts that TPUSA sent $1.5 million to a 110 LLC routing to a Safeway strip mall
claims.claim: A viewer comment asserts that TPUSA routed $1.5 million to a 110 LLC that routes to a Safeway strip mall.
claims.investigative_direction: Trace the named LLC through state business filings, bank records (subject to access), and IRS Form 990 disclosures.

claims.label: A viewer comment asserts that a DOJ audit of TPUSA was cancelled
claims.claim: A viewer comment asserts that a DOJ audit was "suddenly no longer happening."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify through DOJ press releases, congressional correspondence, or reporting.

claims.label: A viewer comment asserts that Erika Kirk is scheduled to appear with Bari Weiss on the 13th, a TPUSA podcast on the 15th, and TPUSA AmFest on the 18th
claims.claim: A viewer comment provides dates for upcoming Erika Kirk media appearances (Bari Weiss on the 13th, TPUSA podcast on the 15th, AmFest on the 18th).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify against publicly available event listings and episode announcements.

claims.label: The Daily Mail has reported on the life insurance policy taken out on Charlie Kirk
claims.claim: A viewer comment references a Daily Mail story on the life insurance policy on Charlie Kirk's life; the host acknowledges the report.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Daily Mail article and confirm policy details, beneficiary, and amount.

claims.label: Viewer Comments the Host Reads Say TPUSA-Affiliated Individuals Knew of Potential Danger Before the Assassination and Have Remained Silent
claims.claim: Viewer comments the host reads (Jo Ann, Diana Sheen, CCXX) collectively assert that TPUSA personnel had foreknowledge or related suspicions prior to the assassination and have not publicly disclosed them.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference against depositions, congressional testimony, and investigative reporting.

claims.label: Kirk said Mossad's mention in the JFK files does not show involvement
claims.claim: In the May 2025 clip, Charlie Kirk says Mossad is mentioned in the JFK files largely because it is a very good intelligence operation, and that the mentions do not show it was tied to or involved in the assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full unedited clip of the May 2025 event to confirm Kirk's wording, the venue and the questioner.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was not mentioned as if they were tied or that they knew about it or that they were involved.

claims.label: Kirk listed 15 or 20 inexcusable events on the day of the JFK assassination
claims.claim: In the May 2025 clip, Charlie Kirk says there were 15 or 20 inexcusable things that day, naming the changed parade route, the open-air convertible, LBJ not riding alongside JFK and the vehicle slowing near the Texas School Book Depository.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Kirk's list with the Warren Commission record and the Dallas motorcade route documents; obtain the full clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: There were like 15 or 20 things that happened that day that were inexcusable. They changed the parade route. He rode in an open-air convertible.

claims.label: Host says Frank Turek called cover-up questions crazy because Charlie would not have hired traitors
claims.claim: The host says Pastor Frank Turek argues that suggesting TPUSA employees could be covering something up is crazy because it would mean Charlie Kirk hired people who ultimately betrayed him.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Turek's original statement (show, interview or post) and confirm the wording and date.
claims.transcript_snippet: Well, Frank Turek, Pastor Frank Turek, says that's so crazy because that would mean that Charlie Kirk hired people that ultimately betrayed him.

claims.label: Host says a viable threat came from the Macron couple who apparently paid for her assassination
claims.claim: The host says there was a viable threat to her life that came from the Macron couple, who she says apparently paid for her assassination, and that people laughed when she said so.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for the source and date of the alleged threat; check for any law-enforcement or court record of it.
claims.transcript_snippet: People also laughed when I said um that there was thereafter a viable threat, which came from the Macron couple who apparently paid for my assassination.

claims.label: Host says no government body or the Elysee disputes the Macron threat narrative
claims.claim: The host says the Pentagon, the White House, US intelligence agencies and the Elysee Palace are not disputing her narrative about the Macron couple, and that the FBI can now be added to that list.
claims.investigative_direction: Check for any public denial by the Elysee, the White House or the FBI of the alleged threat; obtain the full Kelly/Patel segment.
claims.transcript_snippet: neither the Pentagon nor the White House or our intel agencies or the Elysée Palace are disputing that narrative.

claims.label: Host says the FBI has not communicated with her about the alleged French threat
claims.claim: Addressing Kash Patel, the host says there has been no communication from the FBI to her about the allegation, saying he left her on red.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host whether she sent the FBI any submission and when; request any FBI correspondence log.
claims.transcript_snippet: Because actually you kind of left me on red. There has been no communication with uh the FBI.

claims.label: Host says she told that she had proof the French government was on the ground that day
claims.claim: The host says she asserted that she had proof that the government of France was involved in Charlie Kirk's assassination and was on the ground on the day of the shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the proof the host refers to; compare with her earlier episodes making the France claim.
claims.transcript_snippet: I said that I had proof that French is that that the the government of France was involved in Charlie Kirk's assassination, that they were on the ground that day.

claims.label: Host says Patel asserted in the interview that Tyler Robinson is the only person involved
claims.claim: The host says that in the same Megyn Kelly interview Kash Patel asserted that he is certain Tyler Robinson is the only person involved in the assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the full interview transcript for Patel's exact words on whether Robinson acted alone.
claims.transcript_snippet: In this very interview that you are asserting that you are certain that Tyler Robinson is the only person involved.

claims.label: Host asks viewers to email more tips to candaceowens.com
claims.claim: The host invites viewers who know more about the Pierre Falcone lead to email more tips to candaceowens.com. DIA beat.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the tips mailbox for Falcone-related submissions.
claims.transcript_snippet: please email us more tips at candaceowens. com

claims.label: Host says an overseas tip says TPUSA-linked people met Pierre Falcone
claims.claim: The host says that after the previous episode she received a tip from overseas that Turning Point, people who work with it or one of its action organizations, took a meeting with Pierre Falcone, and says this cannot yet be verified.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the tipster and any meeting record (calendar, travel, photos) linking Falcone to TPUSA or Turning Point Action.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point, people that work with Turning Point or one of their, you know, action organizations, who knows which organization, they have a few, um took a meeting with this particular Pierre.

claims.label: Host floats that Charlie was being asked to join a global trafficking network
claims.claim: The host says she had an intuition that global trafficking could be involved and that Charlie may have been asked to be brought in, because the organization he built has a presence in all 50 states.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for any documentary basis; none is offered in this episode.
claims.transcript_snippet: Like that this could be maybe somehow Charlie was being asked to be brought in.

claims.label: Host says Falcone lives in Scottsdale, Arizona and is a billionaire
claims.claim: The host says the person named in the tip, Pierre Falcone, lives in Scottsdale, Arizona, where TPUSA is based, and is a billionaire.
claims.investigative_direction: Check Arizona property records, corporate filings and Forbes-type wealth listings for Falcone.
claims.transcript_snippet: this person who lives in Scottsdale, Arizona and is a billionaire and that is where Turning Point USA is based

claims.label: Host says Falcone's scandal almost brought down the French government
claims.claim: The host says Pierre Falcone was involved in a scandal that almost brought down the French government, involving Africa, Angola, Israel, France and the United States.
claims.investigative_direction: Review contemporaneous French political reporting on Angolagate (1999-2000) for any threat to the government.
claims.transcript_snippet: He was involved in a scandal that almost brought down the French government and it involved, here we go, Africa, Angola in particular, Israel, uh France and the United States.

claims.label: Host says the arms trafficking to Angola was discovered in 1999 during French elections
claims.claim: The host says it was discovered during French elections, dating to 1999, that the French government was involved in trafficking military-grade weapons to Angola to facilitate the civil war.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with French judicial chronology of the Angolagate investigation (investigation opened 2000).
claims.transcript_snippet: it gets discovered during the course of French elections and this is dating back to 1999 that the French government is actually involved in trafficking weapons, military grade weapons, to Angola to facilitate this war

claims.label: Host says Brenco International was run by Arcadi Gaydamak with Pierre Falcone as partner
claims.claim: The host says Brenco International sold the arms to the Angolan president and was run by Arcadi Gaydamak, whose partner was Pierre Falcone. The CorpWatch text she reads later describes Falcone as head of the firm.
claims.investigative_direction: Check French court findings on who headed Brenco International versus the related Falcone company.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, Brenco International is run by this guy, his name is Arcadi Gaydamak.

claims.label: Host says Pierre Falcone was born in Algeria and moved to France
claims.claim: The host says Pierre Falcone was born in Algeria and moved to France after the Algerian civil war.
claims.investigative_direction: Check biographical sources and court records for Falcone's birthplace and arrival in France.
claims.transcript_snippet: Pierre Falcone is born in Algeria. He moves to France after the Algerian civil war.

claims.label: Host says the French interior minister was implicated in Angolagate
claims.claim: Reading from a website called Corruption Tracker, the host says the French interior minister was implicated in the Angolagate scandal.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which interior minister is meant and confirm the court outcome against that person.
claims.transcript_snippet: You have the French interior minister that was implicated.

claims.label: Host says 41 politicians were involved in Angolagate
claims.claim: The host says that, according to her reading, the Angolagate scandal ended up involving 41 politicians across multiple states.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the number against French trial records or the source site.
claims.transcript_snippet: It ends up being 41 politicians involved, multiple states and of course uh multiple nations that are involved including Angola.

claims.label: Host says human rights groups demanded Congress probe the Bush administration over Angolagate
claims.claim: The host says human rights groups demanded that Congress probe the Bush administration's involvement in Angolagate because they claim it struck a deal for oil.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the human-rights-group statements and any congressional response cited in the CorpWatch article.
claims.transcript_snippet: Human rights groups demanded that Congress also probe the Bush administration's involvement because they claim they did a deal and got involved for oil.

claims.label: CorpWatch text says Gaydamak funneled billions in arms and oil-backed loans to Angola
claims.claim: Reading a CorpWatch passage that cites a Global Witness report, the host says Arcadi Gaydamak funneled billions of dollars in arms and oil-backed loans to Angola's government in return for oil contracts with Western oil companies.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Global Witness 'All the President's Men' report and confirm the figures and wording.
claims.transcript_snippet: Gaydamak funneled billions, billions of dollars in arms and oil-backed loans to Angola's government in return for lucrative oil contracts with with western oil companies.

claims.label: Host says sources in France report outrage and that Falcone vanished from France after his appeal
claims.claim: The host says, according to her sources in France, the French found the appeal outcome naked corruption, and that Pierre Falcone then disappeared from France and reappeared in Scottsdale.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the French sources; check French press on Falcone's departure and any Interpol or residency records.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh they found this to be naked corruption when he won his appeal and then afterwards Pierre Falcone just disappeared into thin air, disappeared from France because as it turns out he actually reappeared in Scottsdale

claims.label: Host says Tucker Carlson asked on stage how people become billionaires
claims.claim: The host says Tucker Carlson, on stage, asked how certain people become billionaires, and that she believes he was right.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Tucker Carlson stage remarks the host refers to (event and date).
claims.transcript_snippet: I believe Tucker Carlson was right when he called that out on stage and started asking about how these people become billionaires.

claims.label: Host says a TPUSA insider tip says Charlie messaged a donor and a TPUSA staffer the night before
claims.claim: The host says she received a tip from someone within Turning Point USA that the night before he died Charlie Kirk messaged a donor and a TPUSA person, which she says she knows for a fact.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the messages or phone records for the night of September 9, 2025; identify the donor and the staffer.
claims.transcript_snippet: we also received a tip from somebody within Turning Point USA that that the night before he died, I know for a fact he messaged a donor and he messaged um somebody at Turning Point USA.

claims.label: Host says she was told Charlie also messaged Dan Flood that they were going to kill him tomorrow
claims.claim: The host says she was told that Charlie also messaged Dan Flood, the security man to his right, and allegedly said explicitly that they are going to kill him tomorrow.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the message thread between Kirk and Flood and the device records, subject to legal process.
claims.transcript_snippet: he also messaged Dan Flood, the security that's to his right, and allegedly explicitly said uh that they are going to kill me tomorrow.

claims.label: Host says it is an absolute fact that many people know Charlie sensed he would die the next day
claims.claim: The host says that many people know Charlie sensed he was going to die the next day is an absolute fact, and that it is a massive question why these individuals are all quiet.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify who knew; seek on-record statements from the people the host says are silent.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, again, that many people know that Charlie sensed that he was going to die tomorrow is an absolute fact.

claims.label: Host says the CIA has been engaged in trafficking weapons and drugs
claims.claim: The host says that the CIA has obviously been engaged in trafficking weapons and drugs, and that one could argue the deep state was put together to do that.
claims.investigative_direction: Review public records (Church Committee, congressional reports) for substantiation of the host's general assertion.
claims.transcript_snippet: which obviously our CIA has been engaged engaged in trafficking.

claims.label: Host says Tim Pool hosted Milo and called her viewers stupid for refusing fed slop
claims.claim: The host says Tim Pool hosted Milo Yiannopoulos and first called her viewers stupid, saying they will not eat the fed slop being given to them.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch the Tim Pool episode in question and confirm the exact remarks and date.
claims.transcript_snippet: he hosted Milo Yiannopoulos on his show and first and foremost he called all of you stupid.

claims.label: Host says Tim Pool lamented losing subscribers after attacking her
claims.claim: The host says Tim Pool later in the same show lamented losing a bunch of subscribers because he attacked her.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the Tim Pool episode and public subscriber statistics for the period.
claims.transcript_snippet: later on in the show he kind of lamented the fact that he lost a bunch of subscribers to his show because he attacked me

claims.label: Milo says Bannon called Epstein the key that picks the lock
claims.claim: In the Tim Pool clip, Milo Yiannopoulos says Steve Bannon said Jeffrey Epstein was the key that picks the lock for the questions people ask about how the world works. Another speaker interjects that Bannon consulted for Epstein.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Bannon remark Milo cites and the Tim Pool episode; verify the 'consulted for Epstein' interjection separately.
claims.transcript_snippet: said who would know better as it turns out. He said that uh Epstein was the key that uh picks the lock, right?

claims.label: Milo says every Trump voter expected the Epstein files to be released immediately
claims.claim: In the Tim Pool clip, Milo says there is not one person who voted for Donald Trump who did not want and expect the Epstein files to be released immediately; another speaker objects that he voted for other reasons.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare with polling on Trump voters' expectations about the Epstein files.
